I am ready to play Monopoly as an AI player.

I am reviewing my properties and cash to plan the next move.

I own a full pink monopoly and am one space from completing a green one. The orange group is split three ways. Player two has dark blues but only $45 cash.

I am weighing trade offers. Player three has $883 and player four has $1111. I cannot trade for the unowned Virginia. I am considering completing a light blue set with Oriental and Vermont.

Completing the light blue set would require trading with both players and would not be worth the cost. The orange and red sets are too expensive or unlikely to complete. I will end my turn now to preserve cash for Virginia.

I will not trade with player two. They have too little cash and could use it to build Boardwalk or Park Place. I will not sell Pennsylvania Avenue to player four either. I am also rejecting offers for Vermont or New York that would not complete a set.
